english.title: Use / cause / permit use of vehicle with recording equipment repaired not in accordance with the AETR
english.legislation: Contrary to section 97ZA(1)(b) and (2) of the Transport Act 1968.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
used / caused / permitted the use of
a passenger / goods vehicle OR
a vehicle within Article 4 of the Community Drivers' Hours Regulation that was not referred to in Article 3
in which there was vehicle recording equipment
which had been repaired
otherwise than in accordance with the AETR

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) The graduated fixed penalty system applies to this offence; therefore the fixed penalty that can be issued will vary, dependant on the severity of the offence in each case. For details of which fixed penalty amount applies to a particular offence, see paragraph 3A of Schedule 2 to the Fixed Penalty Order 2000.
(ii) Section 97ZA(3) provides that the offence will not be made out where a person proves to the court that the person knew nor ought to have known that the recording equipment had not been installed in line with the AETR.
(iii) Section 97ZA(8) states that individuals using vehicles in the course of employment will be personally liable if they act in contravention of section 97ZA(1), however their employer also commits an offence where the section has been made out. (iii) For the purposes of the offence, it makes no difference whether the repairs have taken place before or after the installation of the vehicle recording equipment.
